definitions.explanation: The extent of one's vocabulary and the ability to use words effectively.

examples.japanese: {語彙力|ごいりょく}を{高|たか}めたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my vocabulary.

examples.japanese: {読書|どくしょ}は{語彙力|ごいりょく}を{伸|の}ばす。
{彼|かれ}は{語彙力|ごいりょく}が{豊|ゆた}かで、いつも{的確|てきかく}な{言葉|ことば}を{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: He has a rich vocabulary and always chooses the right words.

notes:
A term commonly used in educational and language learning contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語彙力|ごいりょく}を{高|たか}める (to improve vocabulary)
- {語彙力|ごいりょく}を{伸|の}ばす (to expand vocabulary)
- {語彙力|ごいりょく}がある (to have vocabulary ability)
- {語彙力|ごいりょく}が{乏|とぼ}しい (to have poor vocabulary)

RELATED TERMS:
- {語彙|ごい}: vocabulary
- {単語|たんご}{力|りょく}: word power
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}: expressive ability
